format: Verify part bytes/SHA256, decode each gzip_base64 and verify its gzip SHA256, decompress and verify chunk bytes/SHA256; concatenate per path in offset order, then verify file bytes/SHA256. Every original text record is reconstructed exactly. Large binary/wheel/SCIP artifacts and source trees remain local/hash-bound.
